breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet (u=0 at x=0 and x=1) and Periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omitted the contradictory periodic boundary condition and only stated the Dirichlet condition, aligning with the ground truth.
